defaultBehavior: Existing private echo proof remains the default; queue mode is explicit opt-in.
requiredFutureAcceptance: Use the existing pinned image and isolated preflight/resource/cleanup checks only after separate execution approval.
Reject wrong-secret REGISTER and INVITE, authenticate registration, and verify the exact sole client contact.
Authenticate INVITE to queue-timeout, send ACK, and validate private PCMU SDP; no RTP echo or human media quality claim.
Observe exactly one PJSIP/proof-client channel in the private context, Queue application with exact arguments, one queued caller and zero members.

Observe the same SIP channel enter bounded result Wait after Queue; require TIMEOUT, QUEUEWAIT_MS from 3000 inclusive to 4000 exclusive, ANSWEREDTIME_MS=0 and ABANDONED=TRUE using the existing validator.
Verify the queue has zero callers at result observation; retain bounded progress even on failure.
Release the client only after host result verification; require client BYE/200 and zero remaining channels.
Authenticate explicit unregistration, verify zero contacts and restored exact queue-policy baseline, retain endpoint configuration.
Require preflight/client/PBX exit zero, unchanged warmed bridge/inventory, owned resource removal and generated credential deletion.

offlineValidation.description: Unit and mocked orchestration checks only; test success is not an executed SIP-to-queue result.
